title: Smooth exceptional base-change mates and tensor-composition pasting
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient datum [def-pur-conventions]: $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k)$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite with uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $\Lambda=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$, $n\geq1$. All schemes are finite-type $k$-schemes; absolute separatedness is not assumed. All morphisms below are separated and of finite type [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Every smooth morphism below is assumed to have a pure relative dimension $d_h\geq0$. Work in the bounded constructible finite-Tor categories [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude] on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], with the derived operations [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and constructible exceptional inverse images [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Write $\omega_h=Rh^!\Lambda$, take $c_{v,u}:R(vu)^!\simeq Ru^!Rv^!$ to be the specified adjunction conjugate of compact-support composition [def-pur-finite-exceptional-composition], and take $\theta_{h,M}$ and $\beta_{h,v}$ to be the specified counit transposes [def-pur-co-smoothness]. For composable smooth maps [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] put $\sigma_{u,v}=c_{v,u,\Lambda}^{-1}\theta_{u,\omega_v}\mathrm{sym}$. All pullback compositions, tensor constraints and unit comparisons below are the canonical derived ones [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition, lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback].
For a Cartesian square with smooth vertical maps $h:X\to Y$, $h':X'\to Y'$ and horizontal maps $u:X'\to X$, $v:Y'\to Y$, define
$$B_{h,v,N}:Lu^*Rh^!N\longrightarrow Rh'^!Lv^*N$$
as the adjunct of $Lv^*\varepsilon_{h,N}\circ\operatorname{Ex}_!^{-1}$, with the transported compact-support exchange, that is, the base-change morphism $b_{v,N}$ of [pur9-cs-def-bc]; $N\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,\Lambda)$. Its unit value is $\beta_{h,v}$, and it is invertible. For a further Cartesian base change $w:Y''\to Y'$ with upper arrow $u':X''\to X'$, the identity
$$B_{h,vw,N}=B_{h',w,Lv^*N}\circ Lu'^*B_{h,v,N}$$
holds, including the identity-base-change normalization. Moreover
$$B_{h,v,N}\circ Lu^*\theta_{h,N}=\theta_{h',Lv^*N}(1\otimes\beta_{h,v}).$$
Let $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ$ and $X'\xrightarrow aY'\xrightarrow bZ'$ be smooth towers with a Cartesian square for each pair $(f,a)$ and $(g,b)$ and vertical comparison arrows $u:X'\to X$, $v:Y'\to Y$, $w:Z'\to Z$. Then, for $N\in D^b_{ctf}(Z,\Lambda)$,
$$c_{b,a,Lw^*N}B_{gf,w,N}=Ra^!(B_{g,w,N})B_{f,v,Rg^!N}Lu^*c_{g,f,N}.$$
In particular, with $A=\beta_{f,v}$, $B=\beta_{g,w}$ and $D=\beta_{gf,w}$,
$$D\,Lu^*\sigma_{f,g}=\sigma_{a,b}(A\otimes La^*B).$$
The tensor and pullback reassociations in these equations agree with either order of canonical reassociation on flat-term K-flat representatives; this includes symmetry, identity and the threefold pullback comparison. No orientation of any $\omega$ is used.

proof.text: Reuse the proved exceptional_base_comp calculation in SectionExceptionalFibreCoherence, with explicit composite arrows transported by their equalities. Its proof uses affineLinearExchange_paste for the specified ordinary etale compact-support exchange, inversion and mate pasting. Apply the comparison functor to obtain base pasting. proof.text: For two vertical towers, unboundedEtaleCompactSupport_baseChange_composition gives compact-support exchange compatibility. Conjugate by leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory and cancel those isomorphisms to obtain ExchangeCompCompatible for the specified unbounded compact-support compositors. Apply Adjunction.mateEquiv_inv_comp_rightAdjointUniq. The proved generic rightAdjointUniq_ofNatIsoLeft_hom identifies the resulting right adjoint isomorphisms with the conjugates defining finiteExceptionalComposition, yielding exceptional_tower_comp. Apply the comparison functor.

source.place: Step 1: remaining smooth-base-change and co-projection constituents

proof.text: At the coefficient unit, naturality of the exceptional compositor with the pullback unit comparison specializes the tower equality to beta_tower_comp. The source theorem boundedConstructibleFiniteTor_dualizingComplex for a smooth pure-dimensional map, followed by constructibleFiniteTor_mapDerivedCategory, puts omega_g in the required tensor-mate domain. Apply tensorMateBaseChange at omega_g. Prove theta naturality directly over a general coefficient category from Adjunction.projectionTensorMap_naturality_right and leftUnitor_naturality, then specialize to the finite coefficient category. This avoids importing SmoothPurityMap for its private helper. Substitute the beta formula, cancel the compositor with its inverse, and move beta_g through theta_a using this naturality. This proves the sigma equation without an orientation.

proof.text: For reassociation work over a general coefficient category and specialize to ModuleCat only after proving all equations. Use the proved source associativity, signed braiding, left and right unit laws for the derived pullback, plus leftDerivedUpperStarComp_assoc'_app and leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison_comp. The four fixed-object derived tensor equations share tensorComparisonCoherenceAt, with their whiskering conversions proved generically. The derived localization square is expressed with its explicit counit maps and is precisely leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison_app_app_comp; the compositor localization equation is leftDerivedUpperStarComp_hom_app_Qh_obj_comp_counit. Factor the four chain tensor equations into tensorComparisonCoherence. For an arbitrary oplax monoidal functor its associativity and unit laws give three equations, and its braiding compatibility gives the fourth. First prove the complex tensor calculation over arbitrary abelian monoidal closed braided categories, then apply it to the actual mapHomologicalComplex functor. The source mapCochainComplex_δ and mapCochainComplex_η identities identify these maps with the displayed total tensor comparison and inverse unit isomorphism. A generic preadditive-category calculation transports pointwise threefold comparison compatibility to cochain complexes degreewise; specialize it to upperStarComp_assoc'. No representative or orientation is chosen. Share the whole threefold complex equation through complexThreefoldComparisonCoherence before specializing it to the actual six pullback functors and four canonical comparison transformations.
